C1131.title: Grandpa Fang Scammed by AI-Cloned Comrade’s Voice
C1131.summary: While walking in the park, Grandpa Fang received a call from someone claiming to be his old comrade 'Lao Qiao,' who said he was ill and urgently needed money. Recognizing the familiar voice, Fang believed it and transferred 2,000 and 8,000 yuan. After the money was sent, 'Lao Qiao' disappeared, and Fang realized he had been scammed.
